description: 1st connection. Two goals, per advisor review of the part02-bsh-tilde-redirect investigation. (1) TESTCLONE checks the untested assumption behind 02-04's repair procedure and explanation: does `git clone ... ~/ibmi-kyozai` under bsh actually create a `~` parent directory and write silently into it (matching what happened with the earlier `>> ~/...` redirect test), or does git itself error out immediately on a literal `~` argument (in which case the 'writes silently' framing in 02-04 would be wrong)? Uses a disposable scratch area under $HOME/vfy, never touching the account's real ibmi-kyozai. (2) CLEANUP removes the real, pre-existing $HOME/~ directory this project's own account has had since 2026-09-25 (confirmed via part02-bsh-tilde-redirect, likely created by this exact bug during that day's testing) - records its full contents first, removes it with an explicit quoted path (never a bare `~`), then confirms $HOME's real entries (ibmi-kyozai, vfy, .profile) are untouched.

steps.label: TESTCLONE
steps.cmd:
mkdir -p "$HOME/vfy/tc" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git init --bare "$HOME/vfy/tc/src.git" 2>&1
/QOpenSys/usr/bin/bsh -c 'cd "$HOME/vfy/tc" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git clone "$HOME/vfy/tc/src.git" ~/cl' 2>&1
echo ---TC-TILDE-DIR---
ls -la "$HOME/vfy/tc/~" 2>&1
echo ---TC-REAL-HOME-UNTOUCHED---
ls -la "$HOME/cl" 2>&1
